name: candidate-soft-oppoint-mixture-sot2931
description: SOT-2931 cycle-6 explore direction C candidate (NOT the live champion; NOT promoted). Reformulates the linking operating point from a single HARD global point / the REJECTED HARD regime label (SOT-2922/2923) into a SOFT per-sequence MIXTURE: a continuous w-weighted average of a conservative (champion motion_gain=1.0, mutual-NN prune off) and an aggressive (motion_gain up to 2.0, mutual-NN prune on) operating point, w=sigmoid((center-median_knn_um)/scale) over SOT-2921's leak-free GT-free density covariate. Structurally DISTINCT from SOT-2922/2923: those pick op in {dense_op,sparse_op} by a STEP function of the covariate (hard label); this picks a BLENDED op whose motion_gain slides continuously with the covariate (the hard switch is the scale->0 degenerate limit, so the soft mixture strictly generalises it). The operating_point_mixture block below is illustrative of the formulation and is READ ONLY when present (default-off: the live champion carries no such block => byte-for-byte champion). VERDICT=INCONCLUSIVE / NOT PROMOTED: leak-free same-seed 4-family LOFO A/B raised micro_adj 0.6760->0.6811 (+0.0051) with macro (0.7310->0.7432) AND lineage-macro (0.7351->0.7491) BOTH up, but FAILED the mandatory 4/4 per-dataset non-regression gate on 6bba_05b6850b (-0.0009 adj) -- the exact family and near-exact delta that broke the SOT-2922 hard switch. The in-sample per-family oracle (leaky ceiling, micro_adj 0.6938) DOES clear 4/4, and its per-family optima are OPPOSITE across families of the SAME covariate side (44b6@8.54 and 6bba_05b6850b@9.49 both moderate/sparse yet want gain=2.0/prune-off vs gain=1.0/prune-on respectively), proving the wall is the covariate's NON-MONOTONE relation to the needed op -- a property shared identically by hard AND soft policies, so softening the partition cannot relax it. Evidence: experiments/sot2931/ab_soft_oppoint_mixture.json. Champion byte-frozen (sha256 f2b1076...6522fc); NO Kaggle submission.

promotion.reason: positive micro (+0.0051) and macro+lineage both up, but fails 4/4 non-regression on 6bba_05b6850b (-0.0009); soft mixture reproduces the SOT-2922 hard-partition failure because the covariate is non-monotone vs the needed operating point
